consent.title: Location at check-in
consent.intro: To confirm that a visit took place at the clinic, Honest OS reads your location once when you check in and once when you check out.
consent.what: What is collected: one GPS position (latitude, longitude and its accuracy) and the time on your phone, at the moment you tap the button.
consent.when: When: only when you tap check-in or check-out. There is no background or continuous tracking.
consent.why: Why: the server compares the position with the clinic's location and marks the visit verified, out of range or low accuracy.
consent.retention: Retention: raw positions are kept for 12 months and then deleted automatically. The visit result (verified or not) is kept as a work record.
consent.access: Who can see it: you can see your own data; your managers see their team's visits.
consent.without: You can check in without location. The visit then needs a manager's approval to count.
